password.tooWeak: Choose a stronger password to continue.

strength.hint: Use 4 or more random words, or 12+ mixed characters.

setup.title: Create your vault
setup.intro: Choose a master password. It encrypts your vault and is never stored or sent anywhere. If you forget it, only your Emergency Kit can open the vault.

kit.title: Your Emergency Kit
kit.intro: This recovery key opens your vault if you forget the master password. It is shown only now. Print it or save it as a PDF, and keep it offline somewhere safe.
kit.warning: Anyone with this key and your vault file can read your passwords.
kit.confirmIntro: Type groups {{a}} and {{b}} of your recovery key.
kit.confirmMismatch: These groups do not match. Check your Emergency Kit.
kit.printHowTo: If you forget your master password
printSteps: Open xpass and choose “Use recovery key” on the unlock screen.
Type the recovery key above. Dashes, spaces and letter case do not matter.
kit.printKeep: Keep this sheet offline. Do not store it on the same computer or in the same cloud account as your vault.

unlock.title: Unlock xpass
unlock.useRecovery: Forgot your password? Use recovery key

recovery.title: Unlock with recovery key
recovery.intro: Enter the recovery key from your Emergency Kit.

newPassword.title: Set a new master password
newPassword.intro: You unlocked the vault with the recovery key. Choose a new master password to continue.
newPassword.kitIntro: Your old recovery key still works. Create a new kit if the old one was lost or someone else may have seen it.

unlocked.title: Vault unlocked
unlocked.body: Entries arrive in the next task of v0.1.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid_input: Some input is missing or invalid.
errors.wrong_recovery_key: This recovery key does not open this vault. It may have been replaced by a newer Emergency Kit.
errors.bad_recovery_key: This recovery key is not valid. Check it for typos.
errors.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
errors.tampered: The vault file was modified or is corrupted. Restore a copy from the backups folder.
errors.invalid_file: This is not a valid xpass vault file.
errors.unsupported_version: This vault was created by a newer version of xpass (format v{{version}}). Update the app.
errors.io: Could not read or write the vault file ({{kind}}).
